title: Weber Number Calculator
purpose: Calculate the ratio of inertia to interfacial-tension effects for a stated characteristic length and relative speed.
assumptions: Required: density, characteristic length and relative speed consistent with the chosen reference phase and phenomenon, with constant interfacial tension. Excluded: inferring universal droplet-breakup, spray or bubble-shape thresholds from We alone.
condition: I confirmed the characteristic length, relative speed and reference phase.
